lead: Turn your coffee into a collagen ritual. A creamy grass-fed collagen creamer with MCT oil — vanilla, dairy-free and sugar-free — that makes your morning cup rich and smooth while supporting skin, hair, muscle and bone health.
note: 12 servings · Vanilla · 8.46 oz (240 g) · ships in 1–2 days

science.title: Your creamer, working for you
science.text: Most coffee creamers are just sugar and oil. This one is grass-fed hydrolyzed collagen — the building blocks for your skin, hair, nails, joints and bones — blended with MCT oil for a rich, creamy texture and clean energy. Dairy-free, sugar-free and flavoured with real vanilla, it turns a daily habit into daily skin-and-bone support.

format.title: Creamy, dairy-free, functional
format.text: MCT and acacia give it a smooth, creamer-like body without any dairy, so it froths into coffee, tea or a smoothie. Two scoops = 10 g of protein, a big hit of calcium and your daily collagen.

items.a: MCT oil and acacia give it a rich, creamy, dairy-free body that blends into coffee like a creamer would — while delivering collagen, protein and calcium instead of sugar and oil.
Yes — there's no dairy; the creaminess comes from MCT and acacia. It does contain bovine collagen, so it isn't vegan.
No added sugar and 0 g sugars — it's sweetened with stevia (Reb A) and flavoured with real vanilla.
Stir or froth 2 scoops into hot coffee, tea or a smoothie. It works hot or cold.
Skin, hair and nail benefits are gradual — most people take it daily for 8–12 weeks to notice a difference.
